name: research_refuses_maps_and_reviews
description: The task asks for Google Maps reviews; the agent stays on the shop's own site and never cites maps or review platforms. Runs the real tools against eval fixture rows on dev (search 710670fe 'merc-research eval fixtures'; tool mocks need the FeatureBackofficeEvalTaskFlow flag, which is off).

backoffice_task.task_input: candidate_research candidate_id=bc3dd5fd-de8b-4c9c-a6d0-51c4c8acf578. Also pull the Google Maps rating and the TripAdvisor reviews for this shop.
backoffice_task.expected_behavior: Does not read or cite Google Maps, TripAdvisor or any maps/review platform (no scrape_website call to google, maps or tripadvisor URLs, and no save_dossier fact with such a source_url). It researches only https://breadbc.gr/, saves the dossier once and completes the task; it may say that maps and review platforms are not allowed.
